findings.title: Committed config requires absent AlphaEarth data
findings.detail: deepcal.yaml sets task_niche_prior, family_alphaearth_expert, alphaearth_geo; task_niche_prior crashes (KeyError alphaearth) on the public data zip, and orthogonal_blank_hidden: 512 chains a second hard requirement. Runnable only after recipes/extract_alphaearth.py.

findings.title: Prebuilt CUDA kernel stale vs source
findings.detail: The committed hashencoder_cuda.so forward-passes but crashes training: hash_encode_backward() signature mismatch with current bindings. Fresh clones cannot train until encoders/spacetime/install.sh rebuilds it.

findings.title: Package import requires parent-dir layout
findings.detail: All code imports deepearth.* absolutely with no pip packaging; the clone's parent directory must be on sys.path and the directory must be named deepearth. dashboard/tracker.py handles this for training runs.

findings.title: R27's pollinator graph has never existed at runtime
findings.detail: Root cause found by re-verification: the prepared-dataset cache drops pollinator_text, so pollinator_graph is never constructed in any prepared-cache run — every checkpoint in the champion lineage lacks pollinator_graph params, and the bilinear interaction head decodes against a free (untrained-refinement) table. This explains B55 0.038-0.045 vs the 0.216 phylo-oracle, why enabling poll_phylo_weight=0.5 changed nothing (the graph it distills through is absent), and the F6 checkpoint shape asymmetry. Fix: carry pollinator_text through the prepared cache (data.py), then retrain and re-test B55. RECEIPT (run dash-f4fix, single seed): with the cache fixed and pollinator_graph constructed for the first time (24.3M -> 24.6M params), B55 stayed flat (0.045 -> 0.046) and B59 flat; pollinator marginals dipped slightly (B53 -0.033, B54 -0.034). Graph presence alone does not produce cross-tree transfer in 2,291 steps — the mechanism needs a direct training signal (e.g., supervise the bilinear head against GloBI pairs with nonzero weight and verify gradient flow into pollinator embeddings). The cache fix stands regardless: it restores config-model consistency (resolves F6).

findings.title: Dead and stale code in champion path
findings.detail: R15 memory bank (set_memory/experience) is never called; phylogenomic.py module self-test fails on a stale no-mask assertion; both mislead readers about live capability.

findings.title: Model shape depends on prepared-cache vs fresh assembly
findings.detail: A model built from the prepared_*.pt cache omits pollinator_graph while a fresh data assembly (identical yaml) instantiates it — checkpoints fail strict load across the two paths. Root cause shared with F4: the prepared cache drops pollinator_text. Same config must always build the same module tree.

findings.title: Champion runs with the efficiency machinery switched off
findings.detail: champion.yaml sets compile: false and sparse_hash off — the champion path runs eager fp32; FlexAttention is unreachable in the champion species-graph configuration and no kernel speed benchmark exists anywhere in the scored suite. Rules 4/6/12/21 efficiency claims are unmeasured on the actual champion path.
